Per 1 januari 2024 starten wij in Brusse: From 1 January 2024, we are starting in Brussels with our first location in Belgium. At Bazellaan 8 in Evere (Brussels ring road), we have our warehouse, staff and equipment based.
Wij staan voor je klaar met ons TOP team: We're ready for you with our TOP team! We're happy to act as a cross-dock and take care of the last mile deliveries for your business. From Brussels, we can deliver throughout Belgium. Of course, we can also take care of transport from the Netherlands to our location in Brussels.
Is de locatie van jouw bedrijf bijvoorbe: Is your company's location in a permit zone, for example? Then a temporary parking permit is needed. De Bresser arranges these permits in good time.
Wij regelen ook het afzetten van bijvoor: We also arrange closures, for example of the road, so the lorry can load or unload the goods without any problems.
Is er een verhuislift nodig op de locati: Is a moving lift needed at the delivery location? No problem, as you'd expect from us, we take care of that too.
Wij leveren dezelfde kwaliteit en servic: We deliver the same quality and services you're used to from us, but now in Belgium. Requests, contact and planning go through Niels van Gestel and Aaron Mutsaers.
